svg.title: Divisome across the envelope
svg.desc: Gram-negative envelope section at the division site: the divisome spans from the FtsZ filament and FtsA/ZipA in the cytoplasm through FtsQLB, FtsW-FtsI, PBP1B and FtsN in the inner membrane to the murein, coupled to the outer membrane by LpoB and Tol-Pal.
